mapper.update: UPDATE ur_trajectory b SET db_status = 0, remark = '清洗数据' WHERE b.db_status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ur_sport_record a WHERE a.id = b.group_id AND a.end_time IS NOT NULL AND a.db_status = 1 AND a.end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '48' HOUR AND (a.end_time < b.gps_time_show or a.start_time > b.gps_time_show) )
